violated_contract: Preparing or reading a task's continuity must not create its immutable execution profile using an unrelated adapter default. Issue #20909 exposed Task Assistant credit errors: prepare_workstream_continuity created an ACP session even when the owner's selected provider was Omi AI, and the later creation profile could not replace that pinned Claude billing lane.
canonical_prevention: Resolve the explicit current creation profile before task preparation or journal access. All shared workstream creation paths use the owner-scoped execution preference and managed Omi when none exists. Existing profiles remain immutable; recovery requires an explicit user action through the expected-generation, idle-only kernel migration transaction, preserving the canonical journal and never automatically resending a billing-rejected turn.
